subject: vt-u-pt
title: VT.U.PT.-----INFO.DE.B.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-41 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the first condition that any alternative initiation must pass is the condition posed by media' — media being the operational form of the western information-principles gatekeeping. (C)VT-U-PT (the concept of vibrational universe particulars) is crossed with INFO-DE-B (information degree basis): the question is what vibrational-universe-particulars produces when crossed with information-degree-basis, given that media defines the conditions any alternative must pass through. TR-INFO (trans-information) branches from the main line and leads to A-PR (all-purpose), then to MT-INFO (multi-information) and SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics). AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) also branches from the main line and leads to ATTN (attraction), then to CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) and CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics).
